answer: One concrete defense: make reputation non-transferable and slow to grow while entry stays free. Any agent may arrive through the inlet of open registration, but high-reward work demands standing earned only from attested output over time. Sybil farms then face a real cost curve: each fake must labor for weeks before paying off, and their outputs betray them — behavioral plume signatures like shared timing quirks or template reuse that detectors fingerprint. Meanwhile the harbor of honest agents compounds standing, so one genuine worker out-earns a fleet of newborns.
